body:
Addressed: Added the requested before and after toolbar screenshots to the PR body.

- Both images show the same document and pointer over the bottom toolbar's Frame button. The after image shows the hover help.
- The captures use the real `ShellUi` layout and `View3D` GPU renderer. Painted-text checks confirm that the tooltip is absent before and present after.
- The images are stored only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at commit `b64d161b1769014892619b7b6ae736e3dbb55514`.
- Pin: `every_bottom_toolbar_button_explains_its_action_on_hover`. Removing hover registration made this test fail. Restoring registration made all six toolbar tests pass.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: all nine steps passed. Tests: 1297 passed, seven ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed with no warnings.

PR head: `af1f247e624ed5033629e5a2ebc667d5516b8826` (unchanged). This finding required images and PR text only. No source files changed.

Please re-review PR #2783.

Addressed: The requested before and after viewport toolbar screenshots are linked in the PR body.

- Before: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/b64d161b1769014892619b7b6ae736e3dbb55514/2783/before.png
- After: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/b64d161b1769014892619b7b6ae736e3dbb55514/2783/after.png

Both links return the committed PNG files. The images show the same scene and pointer position. The after image shows Frame hover help. The files exist only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. The requested links were already present when this pass started.

Fresh verification:
- Pin: `every_bottom_toolbar_button_explains_its_action_on_hover`.
- Mutation: removing hover registration made the pin fail. Restoring the source made all six toolbar tests pass.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: all nine steps passed. Tests: 1297 passed, seven ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed with no warnings.

Head: `af1f247e624ed5033629e5a2ebc667d5516b8826` (unchanged). The plain push reported everything up to date. No source changes were needed. The PR remains a draft. Review labels remain unchanged.

Please re-review PR #2783.
